title: CL-S Ceiling Adapter
sub_title: Ceiling adapter for AIR-S series subwoofers
description:
Suspended ceiling install for AIR-S subwoofers

The CL-S is MAG Audio's dedicated ceiling adapter family for the AIR-S installation subwoofers (AIR-S12, AIR-S15, AIR-S18 and their IP-rated counterparts). It hangs the cabinet securely overhead so low frequencies can be placed above the listening plane in clubs, lobbies and retail builds without sacrificing the rest of the floorplan.

  • Three size variants - CL-S12, CL-S15 and CL-S18 - matched to each AIR-S enclosure
  • Compatible with both standard and IP weather-resistant subwoofer versions
  • Reliable factory-engineered hardware sized for the corresponding cabinet weight

Like the rest of MAG's AIR mounting line, CL-S is a budget-friendly, install-friendly solution that gets sub-bass off the ground and out of the way for permanent installations indoors or out.

title: LAIR-122 Mounting U-Bracket
sub_title: Wall or ceiling U-bracket for AIR-122 speakers
description:
Dedicated U-bracket for AIR-122

LAIR-122 is the factory U-bracket sized for the MAG Audio AIR-122 two-way installation loudspeaker. It carries the cabinet on wall or ceiling while preserving the speaker's full tilt and rotation range, so coverage can be tuned to the room after the box is up.

  • Purpose-built for the AIR-122 and the weather-resistant AIR-122-IP
  • Wall or ceiling mounting, indoor or outdoor with the IP variant
  • Lightweight, install-friendly hardware engineered by MAG for the matching enclosure

Like the rest of MAG's LAIR line, the bracket is positioned as a budget-friendly, beginner-friendly solution that takes the guesswork out of permanent AIR-series installs in retail, hospitality and touring rigs.

title: LLS Low-Profile Wall Bracket
sub_title: Low-profile wall mount for AIR-S series subwoofers
description:
Tight-to-wall mounting for AIR-S subs

The LLS is a low-profile wall bracket engineered for the MAG Audio AIR-S series of installation subwoofers. Its compact two-part construction pulls the cabinet as close to the wall as possible, freeing up valuable floor space in clubs, restaurants, retail and back-of-house equipment rooms.

  • Two-part design installs quickly - one half goes on the wall, the other on the subwoofer
  • Locking bolt underneath the cabinet adds positive mechanical security
  • Works with AIR-S12, AIR-S15, AIR-S18 and their IP weather-resistant versions

Like the rest of MAG's AIR mounting line, the LLS is an affordable, install-friendly solution sized correctly at the factory for the matching subwoofer cabinet.

title: AIR-CL Ceiling Mount
sub_title: Ceiling mount for AIR-C6 and AIR-C8 speakers
description:
Overhead mount for the larger AIR-C cabinets

AIR-CL is MAG Audio's dedicated ceiling-mount accessory for the AIR-C6 and AIR-C8 installation loudspeakers. It suspends the speaker from the ceiling while leaving the full aiming range of the cabinet usable so coverage can be set after install.

  • Matched to the AIR-C6 (6.5") and AIR-C8 (8") two-way installation cabinets
  • Ceiling mounting with adjustable angle for room tuning
  • Factory-engineered hardware sized for the AIR-C cabinet weight and shape

Part of the MAG AIR-C accessory line - an affordable, install-friendly system aimed at retail, hospitality, clubs and small entertainment venues where permanent overhead placement is needed.
